description: Adding a language with an alias beside the workspace's languages: whether the alias rule lets it in. The web form (workspace-languages.test.ts) and the server (apps/server/internal/workspace/language_test.go) both run every case, so the two rules cannot drift. A code or alias names a language only through the static table or a well-formed tag naming its region (Chinese also its script), never through CLDR likely subtags.

cases.name: an alias naming its own language
an ISO 639-2 code is no language without CLDR
Chinese without its script names no language
a base code naming another language
a base code naming a language the workspace lacks
a region tag outside the table naming another language
a region tag outside the table naming a language the workspace lacks
a region tag outside the table naming its own language
an alias used twice, whatever its case
a stored alias naming the new language
a language already in the workspace under its legacy code
